model.description: Entity model to use for building this snapshot.

condition.description: Query condition to use for building this snapshot.

timeoutMillis.description: The maximum time to wait in milliseconds for the query to complete.

limit.description: Caps the matched result set; not a page size. A matched set larger than `limit` is rejected rather than returned as a truncated prefix. Values below 1 are rejected.

path.description: A dotted scalar path in the entity data (`price`, `address.city`; the `$.` leader is optional) or, with `source: "meta"`, a canonical meta field name. Array subscripts and projections (`items[*].name`, `items[0].name`) are rejected — an ordering needs a single scalar — as is any character outside `A-Za-z0-9_-`. Refused paths answer `INVALID_FIELD_PATH`.

trackingRead.description: When true and this search runs inside an active transaction, the entities it returns are recorded into the transaction's read-set so commit-time first-committer-wins validates them. Defaults to false. Ignored outside a transaction.
